purpose: Lawful, open-licensed reference sources for skin/melanoma/cell histology + a microscopy-method visual-language map. References are DESIGN references (analyze visual principles); do not copy protected artwork. Verify each asset's license before any reuse.

microscopy_methods.visible: tissue architecture; nuclei (haematoxylin, blue-purple); cytoplasm/ECM (eosin, pink)
microscopy_methods.note: pink/purple are stain colors, NOT natural tissue colors
channel colors are assigned, not real

microscopy_methods.visible: ultrastructure: corneocyte lipid lamellae, membranes, organelles, nanoparticle morphology (grayscale)
microscopy_methods.use: SC lipid lamellae + NP morphology reference
particle localization style (as in Huang-type imaging elsewhere)

pipeline_rule: every transition labelled by SCALE; the final animation must NOT pretend to be a single microscopy method if it blends several - a legend states the visual mode

open_license_sources.source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology (5.1 Layers of the Skin)

open_license_sources.use: tissue/cell IHC & IF images (skin, melanoma, cell lines)

open_license_sources.license: per-file (CC BY / CC BY-SA / PD - verify each)
proprietary (design reference ONLY; do not reuse images)

reuse_rules: prefer CC BY / CC BY-SA / public-domain
DermNet/textbook proprietary images = design reference only, never embedded
verify every Wikimedia/HPA file's specific license before use
